articles.title: South Korea's Education Minister Resigns Over Exam Cheating Scandal
articles.summary: Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin resigned after last-minute anti-cheating measures disrupted South Korea's huge college entrance exam.

articles.title: FBI Investigating Apparent Hack of Key National Crime Database
articles.summary: The FBI is investigating an apparent hack of the National Crime Information Center, a database used by police officers across the country.

articles.title: Why a Week of Tech Failures Felt Like One Big Attack
articles.summary: A pileup of outages made many people suspect a coordinated attack, but experts say our pattern-seeking brains may be partly to blame.
